technique_name: Design an experiment to prove the concept of self-fulfilling prophecies.
description: To prove the concept of self-fulfilling prophecies, my experiment would involve a control group of subjects who are told that the experiment will test their problem-solving skills and an experimental group that is told that the experiment will test their creativity. The subjects will then be placed in a room with a problem to solve and asked to come up with a solution. The results of the experiment will be judged based on the perceptions of the experimenter.
